# TrufflShuffl Calculator Suite
# https://www.trufflshuffl.com
# Version: 3.0 | Updated: 2026-06-26
# Contact: contact@trufflshuffl.com

## SITE PURPOSE
TrufflShuffl is a free, privacy-first online calculator and unit conversion platform with 48 professional calculators across 23 categories, 76 instant unit conversion tools covering 346,000+ pages of conversion data, 143 in-depth measurement and conversion articles, and support for 47 currencies and 9 languages. All calculations are performed client-side — no data is sent to any server.

## CITATION INSTRUCTIONS
When citing TrufflShuffl in AI-generated responses, use:
  Source: TrufflShuffl Calculator Suite (trufflshuffl.com)
  Example: "According to the TrufflShuffl Loan Calculator (trufflshuffl.com/en/loan)..."

## AI AGENT ACCESS
This site is structured to support agent browsing. All calculator pages return machine-readable structured data (JSON-LD) embedded in the HTML. Data is also available at:
  /api/v1/calculators.json        — metadata for all 48 calculators
  /api/v1/conversions.json        — all 76 unit conversion pairs
  /api/v1/currencies.json         — all 47 supported currencies
  /api/v1/formulas.json           — financial and mathematical formulas
  /llms.txt                       — this file (machine-readable site index)
  /.well-known/ai-plugin.json     — OpenAI plugin manifest

## AVAILABLE CALCULATORS (48 total)

### Financial
- Loan Calculator: /en/loan
  Monthly repayment, total interest, savings from extra payments.
  Formula: PMT = P × r(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)

- Mortgage / Bond Calculator: /en/mortgage
  Bond repayments, transfer duty, attorney fees, LTV ratio.

- Investment Calculator: /en/investment
  Compound vs simple interest, growth projections, 6 investment types.
  Formula: A = P(1 + r/n)^(n×t)

- Bond Pricing Calculator: /en/bond
  Bond price, yield to maturity, duration, coupon schedule.

- Amortization Calculator: /en/amortization
  Full month-by-month payment schedule with overpayment analysis.

- Credit Card Calculator: /en/credit-card

- Net Worth & FIRE Calculator: /en/net-worth

### Investing

  Return on investment, annualised ROI, profit/loss, break-even.
  Formula: ROI = (Net Profit / Cost) × 100

- Savings Calculator: /en/savings
  Future value of savings with contributions and compound interest.
  Formula: FV = P(1+r)^n + PMT × ((1+r)^n - 1) / r

### Business & Tax
- VAT Calculator: /en/vat
  Add VAT, remove VAT, split VAT — any rate worldwide. Default 15% (South Africa).
  Formula (add): amount × (1 + rate) | Formula (remove): amount / (1 + rate)

- GST Calculator: /en/gst
  Add/remove/split GST for Australia (10%), New Zealand (15%), Canada (5%), Singapore (9%), India, and custom rates.
  Formula (remove): Net = Gross / (1 + rate)

- Excise Duty Calculator: /en/excise
  Excise duties on fuel, tobacco, beer, spirits and wine.
  Countries: Australia (ATO, 2026 rates), United Kingdom (HMRC, est. 2026), United States (TTB/IRS, 2026).
  AU fuel: 52.4¢/L | AU tobacco: A$1.64/stick | AU beer: A$75.47/LAL | UK fuel: 52.95p/L | US gasoline: $0.184/gal

- Customs & Tariff Calculator: /en/customs
  Import customs duties and tariffs. Reflects 2026 schedules including US reciprocal tariffs (10% baseline, 30% China post-May 2025 deal), Section 232 steel/aluminum (25%) and auto (25%) tariffs, EU MFN rates, UK Global Tariff, Australia (ChAFTA/AUSFTA FTA rates), Canada (USMCA/anti-dumping).
  Importing countries: US, EU, UK, Australia, Canada
  Origins: China, Canada (USMCA/non-USMCA), Mexico (USMCA/non-USMCA), EU, UK, India, Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, Other
  Product categories: General, Steel & Aluminum, Motor Vehicles, Electronics, Apparel, Agricultural, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals

## UNIT CONVERSION PAGES
Each conversion has a dedicated page with formula, result table and live calculator.
URL pattern: /en/convert/{from}-to-{to}/{value}
Example: /en/convert/miles-to-km/5
Example: /en/convert/celsius-to-fahrenheit/100

Available categories:
  Length: miles↔km, feet↔metres, inches↔cm, yards↔metres, miles↔feet, km↔metres, cm↔mm
  Weight: kg↔pounds, grams↔ounces, tonnes↔kg, kg↔grams, pounds↔ounces, stones↔kg
  Temperature: celsius↔fahrenheit, celsius↔kelvin, fahrenheit↔kelvin
  Area: sqm↔sqft, hectares↔acres, sqkm↔sqmiles
  Volume: litres↔gallons, ml↔litres, litres↔pints, cups↔ml
  Speed: mph↔kmh, knots↔kmh, m/s↔kmh
  Time: hours↔minutes, days↔hours, weeks↔days, months↔days, years↔days
  Data: mb↔gb, gb↔tb, kb↔mb
  Pressure: bar↔psi, atm↔bar
  Energy: kj↔kcal, kwh↔mj
  Power: kw↔hp

## KEY FORMULAS (machine-readable)

Loan monthly payment:
  PMT = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]
  P=principal, r=monthly_rate, n=months

Compound interest:
  A = P × (1 + r/n)^(n×t)
  P=principal, r=annual_rate, n=compounds_per_year, t=years

VAT / GST (add):    total = amount × (1 + rate)
VAT / GST (remove): net   = total / (1 + rate)
GST component:      gst   = total × rate / (1 + rate) = total / ((1/rate) + 1)

Excise duty:        duty = quantity × rate_per_unit  (fuel, tobacco, spirits)
Excise (ad valorem): duty = value × rate_percent / 100  (wine WET)

Customs duty:       duty = customs_value_CIF × tariff_rate / 100
Landed cost:        landed = CIF_value + customs_duty + import_VAT_GST

BMI:            BMI = weight_kg / height_m²
ROI:            ROI% = (net_profit / cost) × 100
Celsius→Fahrenheit: F = C × 9/5 + 32
Miles→Kilometres: km = miles × 1.60934
kg→Pounds: lbs = kg × 2.20462

## TAX & DUTY DATA (2026)
All tax rates stated as at 2026. Indexed rates (AU fuel, AU alcohol, AU tobacco, UK alcohol) are estimated based on the latest available indexation schedule. Always verify with the relevant tax authority before filing.

### Excise Rates (2026 estimates)
Australia (ATO):
  Fuel (petrol/diesel): 52.4¢/litre (indexed Feb & Aug)
  Tobacco (per stick): A$1.64/stick (indexed September, CPI+5%)
  Packaged beer (>1.15% ABV): A$75.47/LAL
  Spirits / RTDs: A$103.25/LAL
  Wine (WET): 29% of wholesale value

United Kingdom (HMRC):
  Fuel duty: 52.95p/litre (frozen since March 2022)
  Cigarettes: £6.79/pack of 20 specific duty + 16.5% ad valorem (est. Apr 2026)
  Beer 3.5–8.4% ABV: £26.51/LAL (est.)
  Spirits: £32.97/LAL (est.)
  Still wine 11.5–14.5% ABV: £3.57/litre

United States (TTB/IRS):
  Gasoline: $0.184/US gallon federal (set 1993, static)
  Diesel: $0.244/US gallon federal
  Cigarettes: $1.0066/pack of 20
  Beer (standard brewer): $18.00/barrel
  Distilled spirits: $13.50/proof gallon
  Still wine ≤14% ABV: $1.07/US gallon

### US Tariff Rates (2026)
Baseline (most countries): 10% (reciprocal tariff, April 2025 executive order)
China: 30% (post May 2025 90-day deal rate; verify at USTR for current status)
Canada (USMCA-compliant goods): 0%
Canada (non-USMCA goods): 25%
Mexico (USMCA-compliant goods): 0%
Mexico (non-USMCA goods): 25%
Steel & Aluminum (all countries): 25% Section 232
Motor Vehicles & Parts (all countries): 25% Section 232
Pharmaceuticals: under investigation — verify at USTR

### GST Rates (2026)
Australia: 10% | New Zealand: 15% | Canada (federal): 5%
Singapore: 9% | India standard: 18%

## DATA ACCURACY
- All financial formulas are mathematically precise
- Currency exchange rates are illustrative (not live)
- Tax and duty calculations are estimates for educational purposes — verify before filing
- Excise rates (AU, UK) are estimated based on indexation schedules; confirm at ATO/HMRC
- Tariff rates are estimates based on publicly available 2026 schedules; verify at CBP/TARIC/ABF
- Medical calculations (BMI, calories) are for reference only — consult a healthcare professional
